description: Commercial overlay district mapped within Residence Districts. Allows local retail and services at grade level while preserving residential character of surrounding area. Residential equivalent is R5.

bulk.max_residential_far: Per R5 district regulations (1.0 to 2.0 depending on configuration)
bulk.total_far_limit: The greater of commercial or residential FAR — no combined FAR cap
bulk.far_note: Commercial portion limited to 2.0 FAR. Residential follows R5 underlying district. Community facility follows §33-20.

height_setback.regulation_type: R5 regulations apply per §35-62 for C1 overlays within R1-R5 equivalent
height_setback.notes: Height and setback follow R5 underlying district regulations as modified by §35-62. Street wall location per §35-61. Verify: C1-2 within higher-density residential (R6-R12) overlay would use §35-63 instead.
height_setback.building_height_note: Commercial portion height controlled by §33-43; residential portion by §23-42

side.requirement: Per §24-35 minimum side yards for commercial portions

rear.requirement: Per R5 regulations; rear yard required at 30 ft depth in residential portion
rear.note: Commercial and residential portions may have different yard requirements

commercial: Local retail: grocery, dry cleaner, restaurant, bank, pharmacy
residential: Conversions per §35-31: existing non-residential buildings pre-1961 may convert to residential without FAR limits
permitted_uses.ground_floor: Commercial uses required at grade level per C1 overlay intent

dob_filing_notes: Confirm residential equivalent (R5) — check zoning map for overlay
C1-2 in R5 area: height/setback follow R5 per §35-62
Commercial FAR limited to 2.0 — verify no conflict with residential FAR
Conversion of pre-1961 building: per §35-31, FAR limits do not apply to change of use
Ground floor must be commercial — verify building program matches overlay intent
DOB: file NB or Alt1. Mixed-use building requires separate commercial and residential analysis
